result.requirement: The system shall generate predictive inventory replenishment alerts for high-velocity items when projected demand exceeds current stock levels within a defined time window.
result.business_need: The business needs to notify store partners of impending stockouts for fast-moving items to prevent order fulfillment failures and maintain customer satisfaction.
functional_behaviour: The system shall analyze historical sales patterns and current trends to forecast future demand for specific items at each Store Partner.
The system shall compare the forecasted demand against the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot to identify potential shortages for high-velocity items.
The system shall automatically generate and transmit a replenishment alert to the Store Partner when a projected shortage is detected.
The system shall allow the Store Partner to acknowledge the alert and update the expected restock date within the Customer Profile context.
The system shall suppress alerts for items that have been flagged as temporarily unavailable or excluded from the high-velocity category.
The system shall log the alert generation and resolution status in the Feedback Record for future model refinement.
related_information_requirements: Current validated quantity of each sellable item at a specific store location
Predictive data regarding anticipated order volumes and item popularity for specific zones
List of items selected by the customer and their quantities
Status flags for availability, partial stock, or temporary unavailability
business_rules: An alert must only be generated for items classified as high-velocity in the Product Catalog.
An alert is triggered only when the projected demand exceeds the current inventory by a defined safety margin.
Alerts must not be generated for items marked as temporarily unavailable in the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot.
The system must recalculate forecasts daily based on the latest Real-Time Inventory Snapshot.

acceptance_criteria.given: A high-velocity item has a current stock of 10 units and the forecast predicts 15 units sold in the next 48 hours.
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the daily inventory check.
acceptance_criteria.then: The system generates a replenishment alert for the Store Partner.

acceptance_criteria.given: A high-velocity item has a current stock of 10 units but is flagged as temporarily unavailable.
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the daily inventory check.
acceptance_criteria.then: The system does not generate a replenishment alert for that item.
